app.title: PS5 Medic
start.check_sub: Checks firmware, payloads, ShadowMount+ and configuration. Read-only.
start.last_none: Nothing has been checked in this session yet.
running.title: Checking the console
running.sub: Reading firmware, processes, files and configuration. Nothing is changed.
start.last_clean_partial: No known problems in the areas that were checked.
start.last_incomplete: Check incomplete: rules are missing or a check area failed. This is not an all-clear.
start.not_tested: Not checked: {n} areas (list in the report)
findings.empty_partial_sub: Nothing was found in the areas that were checked. That does not mean everything is fine: not checked were {list}.
detail.pending: Provisional ({k} of {n} checks in a row)
selftest.title: Self-test
selftest.sub: Quick and Standard only read. “Thorough” loads the CPU and writes a test file. “Passed” means “nothing stood out”, never “healthy”.
selftest.confirm_read: The self-test reads up to 128 MiB from an image (at most 15 s), checks the rest from information already read and sends a few connection attempts to the router in your own network (local only, no data, never to the internet). Only the marker under /data/ps5medic/selftest is written. Do not start a game or switch the console off. Takes about {s} s. Circle cancels after the current test.
selftest.confirm_none: The self-test only reads information Medic has already collected. Only the marker under /data/ps5medic/selftest is written. Takes about {s} seconds.
selftest.summary: Last run: {p} passed, {w} warning(s), {f} failed, {s} skipped. The rest did not run.
selftest.confirm_title_thorough: Start the thorough self-test? It puts load on the console.
selftest.confirm_thorough: Thorough test: about 20 s of load on almost all cores (stops at 85 °C, starts only below 70 °C), then a 128 MiB memory test and 256 MiB written to ONE test file under /data/ps5medic/selftest and read back (overwritten, never deleted; at most once a day). Do not start a game or switch the console off; keep it ventilated. Takes about {s} s. Circle cancels.
selftest.reason.budget_unwritable: write budget cannot be saved, test not started
selftest.reason.marker_unwritable: marker not writable, test not started
selftest.save_failed: The result could not be saved.
preview.too_big: Too many lines for the preview: the change will be written but is not listed here.
selftest.reason.budget_unreadable: write budget unreadable, test not started
selftest.reason.slow_read: barely read within the time (drive very slow)
usertest.display_hint: Pattern {i} of {n}: Cross = next, Circle = cancel
usertest.display_question: Did you notice dead or wrongly coloured dots, stripes, flicker or an uneven gradient in the colour fields? Medic cannot see this; your judgement counts. Without an answer it counts as “don't know”.
selftest.reason.fan_controller: fan controlled by an app: keeps the console cool (weak evidence)
detail.fix_none: No automatic repair. Please follow the explanation above.
fixprev.title: Review repair
fixprev.nothing: There is nothing to change here.
fixprev.range: Changes {from}-{to} of {n} (Up/Down to scroll; confirming applies all)
fixprev.backup: A backup is made first. You can undo the repair from the history.
fixprev.bk_created: New file – undo sets it aside
fixprev.bk_move: No copy needed – undo moves it back
fixprev.bk_chmod: Old permissions are kept in the journal
fixdone.ok_sub: Transaction {txn}. You can undo it from the history.
fixdone.verified_fixed: Checked again: {rule} is no longer reported.
fixdone.verified_persists: Checked again: {rule} is still reported. The repair was not enough, or the cause lies elsewhere. Details are in the findings list.
history.title: History
undo.title: Undo this repair?
undo.body: The repair “{fix}” from {ts} will be reverted. Backed-up files go back to their place.
fixdone.restart_hint: The change often only takes effect after a restart: ShadowMount+ and the Payload Manager read their settings and folders only at start. Restart the console and then run a new check-up.
report.title: Report
report.err.no_write: The report could not be saved (no write access). The QR code still contains the short version.
report.err.write_failed: The report could not be saved (write error under /data/ps5medic/reports). The QR code still contains the short version.
report.scan: Scan the QR code with your phone camera: the text can be copied and pasted into a forum or issue.
report.truncated: The QR code only contains a short version, some findings are missing. The full report is in the file.
report.anon: Anonymized: IP and MAC addresses, user and account IDs, serial numbers. File and folder names are included, check before sharing.
report.support_saved: Support package saved: {path}. The key for it (do not share) is at {key}.
report.support_err.no_write: The support package could not be saved (no write access to /data/ps5medic).
report.support_err.write_failed: The support package could not be saved (one with this time already exists or writing failed).
report.qr_failed: The short version is too long for a QR code.
update.title: Rule update
update.howto: Put rules.json and rules.json.sha256 (and/or error_codes.json and error_codes.json.sha256) into /data/ps5medic/knowledge/update/ via FTP or USB and open this screen again. Or download them with Square (address in /data/ps5medic/config.ini; the network is only used after your confirmation).
update.sha: The SHA-256 checksum matches the file: {sha}
update.backup_note: The current rules file is backed up, nothing is deleted. Then start a new check-up.
update.rejected.no_rules_file: Only a checksum is there, rules.json is missing.
update.rejected.no_checksum: The file rules.json.sha256 is missing or does not contain a valid SHA-256 (64 hex characters).
update.rejected.checksum_mismatch: The checksum does not match the file: it is damaged, incomplete or the wrong version. Nothing was changed.
update.rejected.invalid_rules: The rules file is invalid or needs a newer PS5 Medic version.
update.rejected.needs_newer_app: The file uses features this PS5 Medic version does not know and needs a newer PS5 Medic version. Nothing was changed.
update.rejected.not_newer: The rules file is not newer than the current one. Nothing to do.
update.rejected.too_large: The rules file is too large (more than 2 MiB).
update.rejected.unreadable: The update file cannot be read.
update.can_rollback: Last installed: {v}. Press the triangle button to restore the previous rules file.
update.confirm_rollback: Restore the previous file (rules and, if installed last, error codes)? The currently active one is put aside, not deleted.
update.next: Start a new check-up so the rules apply.
update.reload_failed: The new file was saved but could not be loaded. It takes effect after restarting the app.
update.failed: The update failed. The active rules file was not changed.
update.error.bad_timestamp: The console clock does not give a valid timestamp.
update.error.nothing_to_roll_back: There is nothing to roll back.
update.error.backup_failed: The current file could not be backed up.
update.error.write_failed: The file could not be written.
update.error.verify_failed: The written file does not match the verified one; the previous file was restored.
update.confirm_download: Download rules from {url}? Fetches rules.json and rules.json.sig, plus error_codes.json and error_codes.json.sig if offered. Nothing is sent or installed; a file without a valid signature is rejected.
update.no_url: No download address is set. Add the line update_url=http://<address>/ (or https://) to /data/ps5medic/config.ini and open this screen again. The signature of the files guarantees authenticity.
update.download_failed: The download failed. Nothing was changed.
update.rejected.sig_malformed: The signature file rules.json.sig is damaged or has an unknown format. Nothing was changed.
update.rejected.sig_unknown_key: The signature comes from a key this PS5 Medic version does not trust. Nothing was changed.
update.rejected.sig_invalid: The signature does not match the file: it was modified or does not come from the author. Nothing was changed.
update.error.bad_url: The address in config.ini is invalid (expected: http://host:port/path/ or https://host/path/).
update.error.no_network: There is no network access in this environment.
update.error.net_resolve: The address name cannot be resolved. Use an IP address.
update.error.net_connect: No connection to the server. Is it running, are address and port right, is a firewall blocking it?
update.error.net_timeout: The server did not answer in time.
update.error.net_redirect: The server redirects. Redirects are not followed; enter the final address.
update.error.net_too_large: The server's answer is larger than allowed.
update.error.net_bad_response: The server's answer is incomplete or not valid HTTP.
settings.title: Settings
settings.not_saved: Could not be saved (no write access).
settings.help.textsize: Larger text for the TV. The change applies immediately; some pages then show fewer lines.
settings.help.contrast: Brighter secondary text and lines, easier to read on a TV.
settings.help.timezone: Left and Right change it by the hour, L1 and R1 by quarter hours. Only affects the display in the app; reports and files stay in UTC. Daylight saving time is set by hand.
settings.help.autostart: Runs a check-up as soon as the app opens. It only reads and changes nothing.
settings.help.rule_dl: Off: Medic never touches the network during the rule update. Rules can then only be installed from a file.
settings.help.net_test: Off: the self-test "Local network" does not contact the router (otherwise only a connection to the router, no data).
settings.help.source: Where the rule download gets the rules: the default address on GitHub or your own address from config.ini (update_url). In use now: {url}
settings.help.source_none: config.ini has no own address (update_url); the default source on GitHub is used: {url}
settings.help.hidden: Findings you have hidden. X opens the list, where they can be shown again.
settings.help.hidden_none: Only a check-up shows which findings are hidden.
settings.help.backups: Space used by the backups made before repairs (/data/ps5medic/backups). Medic never deletes anything; undo under "More → Backups and undo".
update.download_off: The rule download is switched off in the settings. Rules can still be installed from a file.
update.error.disabled: The rule download is switched off in the settings.

errors.readonly: Look-up only: PS5 Medic changes nothing here. The steps are instructions for you to follow yourself.
errors.steps_none: No steps are documented for this code.
errors.community_note: There is no Sony help page for this code. The details come from community reports and are not confirmed by Sony.

errors.live_none: Run a check-up and Medic shows the console's current state here.
errors.source_scan: Scan the QR code with your phone camera and read the source on the phone. PS5 Medic does not open the address itself.
errors.source_qr_failed: The address is too long for a QR code.

padtest.title: Controller test
padtest.intro: Checks what the controller reports to the console: buttons, both sticks (drift and full range), L2/R2, touchpad and motion sensors. Nothing is changed and nothing is sent to the controller. The Create and PS buttons never reach an app and cannot be checked. Medic does not check vibration, light bar, adaptive triggers or battery level yet.
padtest.intro_none: No controller state received yet. A connected controller is needed.
padtest.summary_sub: Result of the controller test. Cross records it in the self-test.
padtest.i.buttons: Press every button once: also the D-pad in all four directions, both stick clicks (L3, R3) and the touchpad as a button. Circle twice in a row ends the step early.
padtest.i.stick_rest: Let go of both sticks and keep still. It measures for about three seconds; if a stick is touched, the measurement starts over.
padtest.i.stick_circle: Turn both sticks once all the way around the edge. Every direction that reaches the edge turns green.
padtest.i.triggers: Press L2 and R2 all the way down and release them.
padtest.i.touchpad: Swipe one finger over the whole touchpad until all fields turn green, and touch it once with two fingers at the same time.
padtest.i.motion: First hold the controller still or lay it down (about two seconds). Then tilt, rotate and shake it briefly.
padtest.deadzone: Suggested dead zone in games: about {pct} %
padtest.sum.triggers: L2 up to {a}, R2 up to {b} of 255, both released
padtest.sum.touchpad: All {n} fields and two fingers detected
padtest.hint.buttons_missing: {m} buttons did not arrive (button, contact or third-party controller).
padtest.hint.stick_drift: Stick off center at rest (left {l} %, right {r} %): larger dead zone or worn stick.
padtest.hint.stick_range: Edge not reached everywhere (left {a}, right {b} of 72): worn stick or turned too briefly.
padtest.hint.trigger_range: A trigger does not reach its end value or does not return (L2 {a}, R2 {b} of 255).
padtest.hint.touch_dead_zone: Not all fields of the touchpad respond ({n} of 18).
padtest.hint.touch_one_finger: With two fingers only one finger arrived.
padtest.hint.motion_none: The motion sensors only deliver zeros.
padtest.hint.motion_gravity: Gravity was not found in either group of values; they do not look like acceleration.
padtest.hint.motion_weak: Only one of the two kinds of motion arrived (acceleration or rotation).
padtest.hint.not_supported: The app does not deliver these values yet (older version).
selftest.reason.not_supported: app does not deliver the values
